prompt_variants.action: Lilja sits in réttir position, begins singing. Voice clear, five-year-old pitch: "Krummi svaf í klettagjá..." But as ZOOM BEGINS, words change. Not deliberately - emerging differently: "Sigrid svaf í klettagjá..." Magnús turns from Sigrid, listening. Lilja continues, words evolving: "Sigrid flýgur úr klettagjá" (Sigrid flies from rocky cleft). "Verður margt að meini" (Much becomes harmful) stays same. "En hún flýgur, hún mun lifa" (But she flies, she will live). The house IS the klettagjá - rocky cleft from lullaby. Wall cracks deepening, becoming cleft-like. Magnús approaches Lilja, confused by changed words. This breaks his focus on Sigrid. She slides along wall, reestablishing 11 feet distance. Lilja continues singing, eyes closed, prophetic trance: "Krummi kemur, Krummi sér" (Raven comes, Raven sees). "Sigrid verður Krummi" (Sigrid becomes Raven). House breathing slows to match lullaby rhythm. Beams stop groaning. Everything listening to prophecy. Through window: actual raven lands on sill. Watching. Waiting.
